summary: Dispatch one coding task and return immediately with a RUNNING task row.

input_schema.workspace_id: string | Identifier of the registered workspace to operate on.
input_schema.prompt: string | Natural-language description of the task for the coding executor.
input_schema.executor: string | optional | null | Override the workspace's default executor (claude_code | codex | opencode).

output_schema.workspace_id: string | Workspace identifier the task was dispatched against.
output_schema.executor: string | The coding executor used for this task.
output_schema.branch: string | Branch name created for the task worktree.
output_schema.prompt_object_ref: string | optional | null | Object Store reference holding the prompt text; null when Object Store is not wired.
output_schema.finished_at: string | optional | Always null on async dispatch; populated only after the task reaches terminal.
output_schema.commit_sha: string | optional | Always null on async dispatch.
output_schema.test_passed: boolean | optional | Always null on async dispatch.
output_schema.stdout_object_ref: string | optional | Populated by the background driver when the executor exits.
output_schema.stderr_object_ref: string | optional | Populated by the background driver when the executor exits.
output_schema.test_stdout_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for test stdout; null until captured.
output_schema.test_stderr_object_ref: string | optional | Object Store reference for test stderr; null until captured.
output_schema.termination_reason: string | optional | Populated when the task terminates.

slash_command.name: code-async
slash_command.description: dispatch a coding task in the background
